title: Enforce autonomous ticket evidence
outcome: A dependency-free Deno validator rejects invalid delivery evidence and accepts one complete exact-revision ticket record.
scope: Workflow validator, CLI, tests, coverage tasks, protocol templates, and current-command documentation
nonGoals: Application scaffold, hooks, CI, main Compose, Playwright, or automatic Git/thread control

acceptanceCriteria.text: Accept a complete exact-revision ticket record.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: A valid bundle fails with not_implemented before production changes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reject every enumerated structural and lifecycle defect with stable diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: Invalid-case tests receive only the bootstrap diagnostic instead of the required path/code.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Expose a deterministic safe ticket-directory CLI and root task.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: The existing CLI returns 1 for a valid directory and no root task exists.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bind RED evidence to an exact test-only revision and SHA-256 test blobs.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: The current result template has no immutable RED revision or blob hashes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Make every workflow template express the accepted packet and review contract.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: Static template assertions fail for the missing readiness, finding, and ledger fields.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reach 100 percent line, branch, and function coverage for production workflow TypeScript.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: The workflow coverage task is absent before implementation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Include workflow files in truthful root formatting, lint, and type gates.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: The current root check omits workflow TypeScript and format omits the skill/config paths.

risks: Secret or personal-data leakage in diagnostics
